$Comment: Wave-2 (scope2-w2 leg A6, gate Q4/section 4.5 flagship exemplar): REPLACES the retired pack Stations/Sawmill.json full-file override. The jar's own Sawmill.json (RPG Stations) stays LIVE untouched, and this ExtensionAsset ADDS to it additively (Target.Station, section 1.8). WHAT THIS EXTENSION NOW CARRIES, one line per payload: (1) Loot.Lootables -> this pack's own SawmillLuckTiers lootable, the MMO-luck tier ladder (see that file's own $Comment for the loot-side rationale); (2) Loot.Rolls[0] -> the MMO-luck-scaled bonus-copy roll restored below. NOTHING ELSE: no Xp (see the A8 note), no Puppet, no Custody. A8 REVIEW FIX (M1): the Xp payload this file originally carried ([{WOODCUTTING, PerCycle 8.0}]) was DROPPED. Because Work.Xp appends rather than replaces (section 1.8 rule 3, unkeyed array), and the jar's own Sawmill.json already authors Work.Xp [{WOODCUTTING 8.0},{CRAFTING 4.0}] (byte-identical to the pre-scope-2 pack total), re-adding WOODCUTTING here DOUBLED the effective total to 16.0/cycle instead of adding a genuinely-new skill. To re-tune the sawmill's XP, edit the jar's Work.Xp; an extension is for ADDING a new skill, never re-adding one the base already grants. BONUS-COPY ROLL RESTORED (2026-07-28, maintainer ruling 4 - BOTH STACK): commit c1018a9 deleted the pack's full-file Stations/Sawmill.json, and its Loot.Rolls[0] (an uncapped mmoskilltree:station_luck bonus-copy Chance) went with it. The wave-2 rebalance deliberately did NOT carry it over, on the reasoning that the jar's own SawmillFinds.json tool_power-scaled bonus-copy roll should cover that niche alone and keep the bonus-copy roll COUNT at one; SawmillLuckTiers.json's own $Comment still documents that now-superseded decision (it is only stale about this one roll, its ladder rationale stands). The maintainer has since ruled that the two roll on DIFFERENT axes and both should fire: the jar's stays untouched and scales off held-tool power, this one scales off MMO luck, so a better hatchet and a luckier woodcutter each earn their own independent extra plank. Restored VERBATIM from the pre-deletion pack file (git show c1018a9^:Server/RpgStations/Stations/Sawmill.json, its Loot.Rolls[0]): BasePercent 0 with a single unweighted mmoskilltree:station_luck AddFactor and NO CapPercent, so effective chance is exactly the player's aggregate station luck in percent and max luck reaches a guaranteed proc (RollEvaluator's absent-CapPercent default of 100 IS the natural single-roll ceiling). The only authoring difference is an EXPLICIT "Trigger": "Cycle": that is Roll#effectiveTrigger's own reader default, so behaviour is identical, but stating it matches the jar's SawmillFinds convention and documents that BonusOutputCopies is only meaningful on a Cycle trigger. Extension Rolls are ADDITIVE onto the base station's Loot (ExtensionCatalog#mergeLoot unions Lootables and Rolls); SawmillLuckTiers.json proves the mechanism from the Lootables side, this roll exercises the inline-Rolls side of the same LootRef.
